prereg.author: patient-exit-program
prereg.discard_if: Discard if give-back USD is not reduced versus base, or net_honest falls below the base's net_honest.
prereg.hypothesis: Locking 33% of peak favorable excursion once the trade arms at 1.0R reduces per-trade give-back USD versus the S6-K2P0 base without lowering net_honest.
prereg.mechanism: Once max-favorable reaches ratchet_arm_r*R, the stop is raised to hold ratchet_lock_frac of the peak MFE, so pullbacks surrender a bounded fraction of unrealized profit instead of the full retrace to the trailing stop.

prereg.author: patient-exit-program
prereg.discard_if: Discard if give-back USD is not reduced versus base, or net_honest falls below the base's net_honest.
prereg.hypothesis: A chandelier stop trailing 3.0xATR below peak (armed at 1.0R) captures more of the MFE and cuts give-back USD versus the S6-K2P0 base without net_honest loss.

prereg.author: patient-exit-program
prereg.discard_if: Discard if give-back USD is not reduced versus base, or net_honest falls below the base's net_honest.
prereg.hypothesis: Raising the ATR trailing floor to 3.0xATR with a 64-bar max hold tightens the worst-case give-back USD versus the S6-K2P0 base while keeping net_honest at or above base.
prereg.mechanism: trail_atr_floor_k widens the minimum trailing distance to k*ATR so the stop never sits closer than that floor, and max_hold_bars caps stale open risk by force-closing trades that have not resolved within 64 bars.

prereg.author: patient-exit-program
prereg.discard_if: Discard if give-back USD is not reduced versus base, or net_honest falls below the base's net_honest.
prereg.hypothesis: A slower parabolic SAR (step 0.002, max 0.03) trails the stop more gently so more of the MFE is captured, reducing give-back USD versus the S6-K2P0 base without net_honest loss.
prereg.mechanism: The slow-SAR acceleration factor grows more slowly, keeping the adaptive stop further from price during the run; max_hold_bars=64 caps stale open risk.

prereg.author: patient-exit-program
prereg.discard_if: Discard if MFE-capture% does not improve versus base, or net_honest falls below the base's net_honest.
prereg.hypothesis: Giving armed trades a 2.0xATR adverse-excursion budget before a break-even exit avoids premature stop-outs on noise, raising MFE-capture% and net_honest versus the S6-K2P0 base.
prereg.mechanism: Once break-even is reached the stop is held at break-even and the trade is only cut when adverse excursion exceeds wait_mae_atr_k*ATR (wait_be_exit=True), tolerating shallow pullbacks instead of exiting on the first touch; max_hold_bars=48 bounds the wait.

prereg.author: patient-exit-program
prereg.discard_if: Discard if MFE-capture% does not improve versus base, or net_honest falls below the base's net_honest.
prereg.hypothesis: Taking the first ficha's profit at 1.0R banks realized give-back-free profit, raising MFE-capture% and net_honest versus the S6-K2P0 base.
prereg.mechanism: f1_tp_r closes the first ficha at the configured R multiple, banking part of the run and letting the remainder trail, which raises realized MFE-capture% on trades that would otherwise round-trip.

prereg.author: patient-exit-program
prereg.discard_if: Discard if MFE-capture% does not improve versus base, or net_honest falls below the base's net_honest.
prereg.hypothesis: A two-rung take-profit ladder (1.0R then 1.5R) banks two partials before the trailing remainder, raising MFE-capture% and net_honest versus the S6-K2P0 base.
prereg.mechanism: f1_tp_r and f2_tp_r close the first two fichas at 1.0R and 1.5R respectively; the third ficha keeps trailing, so more of the excursion is realized on partial retraces.

prereg.author: patient-exit-program
prereg.discard_if: Discard if give-back USD is not reduced versus base, or net_honest falls below the base's net_honest.
prereg.hypothesis: Delaying the trailing stop until the trade reaches 1.0R lets the initial SL breathe early then tightens once in profit, reducing give-back USD versus the S6-K2P0 base without net_honest loss.
prereg.mechanism: trail_arm_r suppresses the trailing ladder until max-favorable reaches 1.0R; before that the fixed initial SL governs, so early noise does not ratchet the stop; max_hold_bars=64 caps stale open risk.
